qc_policy: a pixel is stored when Sen2Cor's SCL (the matching L2A) calls it water (class 6), it lies more than 1000 m from an SCL cloud shadow, cloud or cirrus pixel (classes 3, 8, 9, 10; buffer MEASURED, see notes), and all four ACOLITE bands are finite and inside [-0.02, 1.7]; everything else is NaN. A band outside its bounds is NaN and counted before any index is formed; an index outside its bounds is NaN and counted
title: Sentinel-2 floating-debris indices (FDI, FAI, NDVI, PI) and the four ACOLITE surface reflectances they use, 20 m, water pixels only, one frame per acquisition — PILOT: MARIDA's 63 scenes and tile 35SMD (Gulf of Gera, Lesvos)
verified: 2026-10-13 from the sandbox: Earth Search STAC for all 63 MARIDA scenes (59 with sentinel-2-l1c and -l2a items, 4 with neither) and for 35SMD 2019-2023 (909 L1C items, 724 datatakes, 415 selected, at most one a day); anonymous GET of https://sentinel-s2-l1c.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/?requestPayment -> <Payer>BucketOwner</Payer>, and the control usgs-landsat -> 403 requester-pays; CDSE product download -> 401 without a token; every tile grid from two SCL assets; ACOLITE's 20 m L2R xrange/yrange equal to the 35SMD grid and its lat/lon equal to the grid's pixel centres to < 0.2 m; the cloud-buffer curve on six cached 2021 Pacific crops
